flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/examples/demo-shop/?lang=de then Open any product, add it to the cart, open the cart and start checkout.
Go through every checkout step until the order is placed. On each step, fill in realistic details for a customer in a German-speaking country. Where a field shows an expected format or an example, follow it exactly.
On each page, before you click its main button, verify that the page is fully usable in German: the whole button is visible, with no part of it cut off by the edge of its box or of the screen, and nothing covers it; the button and the page's labels and messages are written in German (no code-like keys, no leftover placeholder text); every value you typed in the format the page asked for was accepted; and every price, shipping cost and total shown looks plausible for this shop and adds up. Then click it.
Verify that an order confirmation appears.
If a verification fails, @v16:"fail the test at that point."

checkout_prices_shipping_total.query: whether the displayed checkout total is a plausible positive euro amount

checkout_prices_shipping_total.code_js: (() => { const raw=el(39).innerText; const value=Number(raw.replace(/[^0-9,.-]/g,'').replace(',','.')); return /Gesamt/.test(raw) && Number.isFinite(value) && value>0 && value<10000; })()

checkout_german_text.query: whether the checkout page main button and page labels and messages written in German with no code-like keys or leftover placeholder text is present (in the checkout content and bottom action bar)

checkout_german_text.subject: the checkout page main button and page labels and messages written in German with no code-like keys or leftover placeholder text
checkout_german_text.code_js: (() => { const t=[el(16).innerText,el(39).innerText,el(41).innerText].join('\n'); return ['Kasse','Schritt 1 von 3','Lieferadresse','Lieferung','Prüfen & bezahlen','Wohin dürfen wir liefern?','Vor- und Nachname','Straße und Hausnummer','Postleitzahl','Telefonnummer','Weiter','Gesamt'].every(s=>t.includes(s)) && !/(\{\{|\}\}|\[object Object\]|undefined|null|TODO|translation|i18n|_key)/i.test(t); })()
